mapper.select: SELECT * FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no=#{chapterNo} AND is_deleted=false

SELECT id, novel_id, chapter_no, volume_no, arc, title, pov, outline_yaml, NULL AS full_text, goal, hook, time_note, rule_refs, foreshadow_refs, budget_min, budget_max, status, round, is_deleted FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND is_deleted=false ORDER BY chapter_no
SELECT MAX(chapter_no) FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND is_deleted=false AND full_text IS NOT NULL AND full_text != ''
SELECT MIN(chapter_no) FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND is_deleted=false AND chapter_no > #{afterNo}
SELECT MAX(chapter_no) FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND is_deleted=false
SELECT MAX(volume_no) FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND is_deleted=false AND volume_no IS NOT NULL

SELECT chapter_no AS "chapterNo", full_text AS "fullText" FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no<=#{maxChapterNo} AND is_deleted=false AND full_text IS NOT NULL AND full_text!='' ORDER BY chapter_no
SELECT full_text FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no=#{chapterNo} AND is_deleted=false AND full_text IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.id, c.novel_id AS "novelId", c.chapter_no AS "chapterNo" FROM chapters c LEFT JOIN digests d ON d.chapter_id = c.id AND d.is_deleted = FALSE WHERE c.status = 'DIGESTED' AND c.is_deleted = FALSE AND d.id IS NULL ORDER BY c.novel_id, c.chapter_no

SELECT chapter_no AS "chapterNo", title, goal, hook, status, budget_min AS "budgetMin", budget_max AS "budgetMax", COALESCE(LENGTH(full_text), 0)::bigint AS "textLen", COALESCE(foreshadow_refs::text, '[]') AS "refs" FROM chapters WHERE novel_id = #{novelId} AND volume_no = #{volNo} AND is_deleted = false ORDER BY chapter_no
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM chapters WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no=#{chapterNo} AND is_deleted=false
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chapters (novel_id, chapter_no, volume_no, arc, title, goal, hook, time_note, rule_refs, foreshadow_refs, budget_min, budget_max, status) VALUES (#{novelId}, #{chapterNo}, #{volumeNo}, #{arc}, #{title}, #{goal}, #{hook}, #{timeNote}, #{ruleRefs}::jsonb, #{foreshadowRefs}::jsonb, #{budgetMin}, #{budgetMax}, 'NEW')
mapper.update: UPDATE chapters SET outline_yaml=#{outlineYaml}, status='OUTLINED', update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{chapterId}
UPDATE chapters SET status='NEW', full_text=NULL, outline_yaml=NULL, round=0, reject_reason=#{reason}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{chapterId} AND is_deleted=false
UPDATE chapters SET reject_reason=NULL, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{chapterId}

UPDATE chapters SET volume_no=#{volumeNo}, arc=#{arc}, title=#{title}, goal=#{goal}, hook=#{hook}, time_note=#{timeNote}, budget_min=#{budgetMin}, budget_max=#{budgetMax}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{chapterId} AND is_deleted=false
UPDATE chapters SET is_deleted=true, delete_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{chapterId} AND is_deleted=false
UPDATE chapters SET status=#{status}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{chapterId}
UPDATE chapters SET status=#{to}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{chapterId} AND status=#{expect}
UPDATE chapters SET status=#{status}, update_time=NOW() WHERE novel_id=#{novelId} AND chapter_no=#{chapterNo} AND is_deleted=false
UPDATE chapters SET full_text=#{fullText}, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{chapterId}
UPDATE chapters SET review_config=#{reviewConfig}::jsonb, update_time=NOW() WHERE id=#{chapterId} AND is_deleted=false
